title: One-line install
tweet: curl -fsSL https://omadesign.app/install | sh Puts omadesign in ~/.local/bin + a desktop entry. Nothing touches /usr. Works on Silverblue, Bazzite, NixOS, SteamOS desktop, Omarchy. glibc 2.35+.

title: Portable ARM64 and x86_64
tweet: Omadesign 0.5.8 ships portable ARM64 and x86_64 tarballs (glibc 2.35+). Same studio on Asahi Omarchy, Ubuntu 22.04+, and current Arch — no Electron wrapper.

title: First five minutes
tweet: Launch omadesign → pick a size, open Templates · 52, or the demo. Design is default: R rectangle, P pen, T type. Pixel (B) paints. Photo opens a folder and grades.

title: Welcome logo 0.5.8
tweet: 0.5.8 welcome: corrected transparent logo, 25% larger, on a dark background. Browser panels and creation buttons fade from the lighter theme color into that dark chrome.

title: Welcome segmented buttons
tweet: 0.5.8 welcome polish: segmented buttons use gradients, utility links use Phosphor icons, project folders get a squarer rounded outline. Make it your studio, not a stub.

title: Persistent title bar
tweet: 0.5.8 keeps the title bar visible so open-document thumbnails stay put when you start working. Menu uses the Omadesign wordmark — no duplicate Open/Preferences noise.

title: Filter icon states
tweet: 0.5.8 welcome filter icon has no button background: hover turns it blue; an active filter turns it red. Small chrome detail that actually reads while you hunt projects.

title: Template chooser width
tweet: 0.5.8 template chooser opens at its final width and stays there as the pointer moves in. No layout jump while you browse the 52 starters.

title: Crash recovery swap
tweet: Idle a second and Omadesign writes ~/.local/share/omadesign/<id>.oma.swp. Save deletes it. Splash Recovered tab lists crash leftovers. Recents lists .oma files you actually opened.

title: Document tabs
tweet: Document tabs sit above the canvas. Ctrl+N new tab, Ctrl+O opens another. Close via the tab button or right-click. Unsaved work asks Save / Discard / Cancel — Affinity familiarity, Linux-native.

title: Five personas one document
tweet: Adobe: Illustrator ↔ Photoshop ↔ After Effects. Affinity: StudioLink across apps. Omadesign: Design, Layout, Pixel, Photo, Motion — one native Linux binary, one .oma, one layer stack.

title: Design persona tools
tweet: Design persona: you're making a mark, poster, or layout. First tools — Move V, Pen P, Rectangle R, Type T. Adobe-familiar keys, no Creative Cloud bounce.

title: Layout persona tools
tweet: Layout persona: screen, landing, dashboard. Frame F, Rectangle R, Type T — UI mockups in the same document as the drawing, not a separate XD/Figma handoff.

title: Pixel persona tools
tweet: Pixel persona: painting or retouching. Brush B, Eraser E, Clone J, Wand W. Raster lives on a pixel layer in the same .oma as your vectors.

title: Photo persona tools
tweet: Photo persona: grade a photograph. Crop C, develop sliders, then Place in Design. RAW stays developed beside the original — Design never rewrites the camera file.

title: Motion persona tools
tweet: Motion persona: animate the artboard you already drew. Space plays, K keys transforms, File → Lottie / animated SVG. Rest pose stays intact in the drawing.

title: Shortcut HUD
tweet: Shortcut HUD along the bottom: upper row follows the current tool; lower row shows letter keys. Hold Ctrl/Shift/Alt to see matching commands. Release — normal hints return. Ctrl+/ toggles.

title: HUD modifiers while drawing
tweet: HUD keeps the same height while modifiers change, so a drag stays anchored. Hover + more for overflow at small windows. Hints never steal keyboard focus. F1 opens the complete list.

title: Omarchy theme chrome
tweet: Chrome follows your desktop: Omarchy theme colors + font from omarchy font current / fontconfig. Icons are Phosphor Light. Override UI type with OMADESIGN_FONT=/path/to/font.ttf.

title: Theme fallback chain
tweet: Theme read order: ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml → ~/.config/omarchy/themes/<current>/colors.toml → stock Omarchy Catppuccin. Linux-native, not a fixed dark skin.

title: Move tool
tweet: Move V: click select, drag move, eight handles scale, top handle rotates. Shift-click add/remove. Alt-drag clones. Shift constrains. Corner dots round a rectangle. Familiar Illustrator muscle memory.

title: Layer reorder shortcuts
tweet: Select a layer row → Ctrl+[ / Ctrl+] reorder; +Shift sends back/front of its group. Drag a layer name onto an insertion line. Groups move with children. Each reorder = one undo.

title: Free transform
tweet: Free transform Ctrl+T puts the selection into Move with scale/rotation handles ready (also under Object). Keeps live text and shape parameters editable — no forced expand.

title: Node tool
tweet: Node A: drag points and Bézier handles. Shift-click adds. Box-select nodes. Drag a segment to move the line. Click a curve to insert. Alt-click corner↔smooth. Alt-drag breaks symmetry. Delete removes points.

title: Break path
tweet: Object → Break path. Shapes convert to a path the first time you edit them. Rotated paths keep visible points/handles aligned with the artwork — edits land where you see them.

title: Flip horizontal vertical
tweet: Right-click artwork or object row → Flip horizontal / Flip vertical (also Object + inspector). Flips follow visible canvas axes even after rotation. Undo restores. Live text: Convert to path first.

title: Pen tool
tweet: Pen P: click corner, click-drag smooth (twitch <3px stays corner). Shift 45°. Alt-drag breaks handles. Enter/double-click finish open. Esc drops last point. Click first point to close. Continue/join open ends.

title: Artboard tool
tweet: Artboard Shift+O: draw a board, drag move, handles scale, top handle rotates. Alt-drag clones. Object → Wrap selection in artboard. Click the name in Transform to rename.

title: Pencil freehand
tweet: Pencil N — freehand curve. Hold Shift to constrain stroke to H/V/45°. Same precision language as Pen and Move, no separate “sketch app.”

title: Shape tools
tweet: Rectangle R / Ellipse O / Polygon Y / Star S / Line L — drag to create. Shift constrains. Corner radius, sides, and inner radius live in Transform. Parameter shapes until you need nodes.

title: Corner radius multi-edit 0.5.8
tweet: 0.5.8: Alt-drag a corner-radius handle → changes all corners in a path. Shift-select several corners, then drag one selected corner’s radius handle to change that set. Faster than Affinity one-by-one.

title: Type tool
tweet: Type T: click to place, type on canvas. First keystroke replaces “Type” placeholder. Enter = new line. Esc/click away finishes. Double-click to edit. Character studio: font, size, tracking, leading, OpenType.

title: OpenType character studio
tweet: Character studio OpenType: kerning, ligatures, tabular figures, small caps. Project fonts from Brand → Typography also appear in the font picker — kit fonts without system install.

title: Gradient eyedropper
tweet: Gradient G — drag across a selected shape. Eyedropper I samples fill. Color studio: HSV, hex, swatches, recent. X swaps fill/stroke. D restores defaults.

title: Trace raster to vector
tweet: Trace U: raster → vector on the active pixel layer. Threshold, color count, smoothness in Trace. Object → Trace to vector does the same without switching tools.

title: Zoom and hand
tweet: Zoom Z: drag a box, click in, Alt-click out. Ctrl-click fits artboard; Ctrl+Shift-click fits selection. Pinch / Ctrl++/- / Ctrl|Alt-scroll zoom canvas (not chrome). Hand H / Space pans.

title: Select same properties
tweet: Select → All / None / Invert / Same Fill / Stroke / Effects / With|Without Fill|Stroke|Effects. Matching compares the complete property (gradients, stroke settings, effect stack). Hidden/locked stay out.

title: Compound paths 0.5.8
tweet: 0.5.8: repeated unions/subtractions create editable compound paths — holes intact. Double-click with Select or Node to edit. Moves, handles, insert, delete, break contour work across the compound. Undo normal.

title: Pathfinder ops
tweet: Object → Pathfinder: Union, Subtract, Intersect, XOR, Divide. Two+ vectors on the same layer. Stacking order matters. Divide makes separate pieces; holes preserved. Each op = one undo.

title: Combine and release
tweet: Combine Ctrl+G / Release Ctrl+Shift+G preserve guide state, rotation, stacking and linear gradients in one undo. Combine and Pathfinder need artwork OR guides — no mixture.

title: Expand stroke
tweet: Object → Expand stroke to outline turns the visible stroke into filled geometry — caps, joins, dashes. Existing fills stay beneath. Compound outlines keep holes; Reshape moves contours together.

title: Reshape distort skew
tweet: Object → Reshape → Distort, Skew, Perspective, or Warp mesh. Nine mesh handles. Shift constrains; Ctrl reverses snapping. Enter finishes; Esc cancels. First moved handle converts live text/shapes to paths.

title: SVG FX stack
tweet: FX studio: SVG filter effects on the selection then the layer beneath — blur, drop/inner shadow, offset, dilate/erode, saturate, hue rotate, brightness, contrast, invert, color matrix, turbulence, displacement.

title: FX export to SVG
tweet: FX params are the SVG ones. They rasterize on canvas and write <filter> / fe* on SVG export. No “live effects that die on share” mystery — the filter graph travels.

title: Layers eye lock
tweet: Layers expand to show objects. Eye and lock work per object. Click a name to select it on the canvas. Groups expand, rename, hide, lock, reorder as units.

title: Pass through blending
tweet: Pass through controls whether child blend modes interact with the backdrop. Disable it for isolated group blending — Photoshop-style group isolation without leaving Design.

title: Ruler guides
tweet: Drag from top ruler → horizontal guide; left ruler → vertical. Drag to move. Delete / drag off canvas / context menu to remove. View → Clear ruler guides. Ctrl+; shows/hides ruler and object guides.

title: Convert selection to guides
tweet: Object → Guides → Convert selection to guides: vectors become editable non-printing contours. Curves, compounds, shapes, live text keep data/style. Move/Node/Reshape still edit. Release guides restores artwork.

title: Guides survive save
tweet: Guides survive project saves and stay out of PNG/JPEG/SVG/Lottie exports. Placed image → guide around bounds, pixels retained. Hidden guides don't capture pointer or snapping.

title: Lock unlock guides 0.5.8
tweet: 0.5.8: View → Guides now has separate Lock all guides and Unlock all guides. Stop accidentally nudging layout rails while you finish type.

title: Ruler zero and units
tweet: Drag rulers' top-left intersection to set zero; double-click resets. Right-click ruler or View → px / mm / cm / in / pt. Physical units follow document DPI — display only, artwork unchanged.

title: Snapping system
tweet: Snapping: object/artboard edges and centers, guides, grid, equal spacing. Alignment lines + gap measurements appear as you move. Ctrl+Shift+; toggles. Hold Ctrl during a drag to reverse, release to restore.

title: Shift constrain Alt clone
tweet: Hold Shift to constrain pen/handles, pencil/brush, object/artboard moves to H/V/45°. Alt-drag clones; +Shift for constrained copy. Mid-brush, Shift anchors constraint at the last free point.

title: Frames nest
tweet: Frame F — drag a frame. Draw another inside and it nests. Object → Wrap selection in frame. Image placeholders live in the inspector. UI mockups beside the illustration, same .oma.

title: Auto-layout stack
tweet: Select a frame → turn on Stack children. Vertical or horizontal, with gap, padding, stretch. Children pack in layer order. Auto-layout without exporting to a separate design-system tool.

title: Frame constraints
tweet: Child of a frame can pin to min, max, both edges, center, or scale when you resize the parent. Constraints that stay in the document — not a prototype-only feature.

title: Export frame
tweet: File → Export frame PNG / SVG / HTML for the selected frame. Ship a component or screen without flattening the whole artboard.

title: Layout templates
tweet: Template library → Layout starters: mobile screen, landing hero, dashboard, card stack. Same 52-template system — Layout persona starters included.

title: Canvas comments
tweet: Comments: write a note, pin it on the canvas, resolve it. Inspector shows open counts on the frame. Review without leaving the native app for a browser-only whiteboard.

title: Pixel layer
tweet: Paint lives on a pixel layer. Add one from Layers if the document is vector-only. Vectors and pixels share the stack — no “flatten to Photoshop to retouch.”

title: Brush eraser fill
tweet: Brush B — size [ ], hardness Shift+[ ]. Eraser E, Fill K, Clone J (Alt-click sets source), Smudge M. Adobe-familiar keys on a Linux-native canvas.

title: Healing brush
tweet: Healing brush Shift+J: Alt-click clean texture on the active image, paint over a blemish. Blends sampled texture with destination local color, preserves transparency. Source fixed for the stroke; Undo whole stroke.

title: Selections pixel
tweet: Marquee, elliptical marquee, lasso, wand. Tolerance lives in Brush. Pixel selection tools sit beside vector tools in the same document.

title: Layer masks
tweet: Layer context menu Mask submenu, or Add layer mask in Pixel: reveal all, hide all, or from current pixel selection. Switch Pixels/Artwork ↔ Mask in inspector. Black hides; white reveals.

title: Mask invert apply
tweet: Masks on pixel and vector layers stay editable. Invert flips; Remove reveals untouched layer. Apply to Pixels bakes to raster — one undo restores both pixels and mask. Placed image masks follow transform.

title: Open photos folder
tweet: Photo: open a photo, browse a folder, drop files, or load samples. Library shows camera metadata when available. Imports run in the background — keep grading while files land.

title: Camera RAW decoder
tweet: Built-in LibRaw 0.22.2: DNG, CR2/CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, ORF, RW2 and more — no external converter download. Full-res sensor decode, 16-bit linear sRGB. Exposure/WB on the linear source.

title: Develop panel groups
tweet: Develop panel: Light, Color, Detail. Tone curve, color mixer, color grading expand when needed. Before compares default development. Auto light balances exposure and contrast.

title: omaphoto sidecars
tweet: Save settings → .omaphoto beside the original. Resume via File → Open, drop, or Library ··· → Open photo or settings…. Pair names (photo.png + photo.png.omaphoto). Original never rewritten.

title: Photo undo history
tweet: Photo edits have their own Undo/Redo. Quitting offers Save all / Discard / Cancel for unsaved photo settings before palette/artwork saves, and waits for writes. Saving Design .oma does not store RAW/settings.

title: Photo export bit depth
tweet: Export JPEG/PNG/TIFF in background at full developed resolution including crop/rotation. RAW PNG/TIFF keep 16-bit channels. Place in Design adds 8-bit developed pixel layer with Undo.

title: Tiled full-res preview
tweet: Initial display preview max edge 1600px. Zoom in for full-res detail prepared in background, shown as visible tiles while the preview stays responsive. Grade big RAWs without freezing the UI.

title: Copy paste adjustments
tweet: Develop → Copy adjustments Ctrl+Shift+C. Select Library targets (Ctrl-click / Shift-range / Ctrl+A). Paste Ctrl+Shift+V with category pick. Crop/rotation off by default so framing stays per photo.

title: Batch save settings
tweet: After paste, Ctrl+S saves selected photos' .omaphoto settings. The batch is one Undo/Redo. Light, color, detail, tone curve, mixer, grading travel independently.

title: omapreset library
tweet: Photo preset library: named looks, filter by name, import/export .omapreset. Presets hold development values + categories — work across unrelated originals. Persists between sessions; name conflicts keep both.

title: Whole folder apply
tweet: Library → Browse folder… → copy adjustments or Use preset → Apply adjustments → Whole folder → Write settings for N photos. Writes .omaphoto in background; pixels untouched. No recursive subfolders.

title: Folder job limits
tweet: Folder jobs: up to 10,000 photos and 32 MiB settings history per job. Progress + file errors visible; cancel stops remaining work; Undo restores completed changes. Externally changed files preserved on Undo.

title: Photo navigation
tweet: Photo view: Space/Hand drag; middle-drag and two-finger scroll pan. Pinch, Ctrl+scroll, Alt+scroll zoom. Ctrl+0 fit; Ctrl+1 at 100%.

title: Rest pose intact
tweet: Motion: the artboard you drew is the rest pose. Motion does not rewrite it. Tracks: X, Y, rotation, scale, opacity, stroke reveal, fill reveal. Clip lives in the .oma.

title: Motion presets
tweet: Select vector artwork → Draw stroke, Pop in, Slam, Shake, Fill up, Slide up/down/left/right, Fly, Zoom, Buzz, Fade in. Draw stroke needs visible stroke; Fill up needs closed fill. Locked/hidden/guides skipped.

title: Timing and energy
tweet: Duration above presets. Timing & energy: delay, stagger, intensity, start-at-playhead. Presets become ordinary keys; each apply has its own Undo. Replace only affected channels in their interval; extend clip if needed.

title: Keyframe editing
tweet: Drag a shape — writes keys at playhead. First key at t>0 also plants rest at 0. K keys X/Y/rotate/scale. Drag diamonds to retime. Delete key / Delete animation (drawing stays) / Delete again removes object.

title: Playback controls
tweet: Space plays. Home/End jump. Loop is the repeat icon. Cycle ease on a selected key. Preview in-persona — no After Effects round-trip for simple motion.

title: Export animated SVG
tweet: File → Export animated SVG… writes animated transforms + stroke/fill reveals, retaining masks and effects. Text outlined in export so glyphs/reveals match; source text stays editable in .oma.

title: Export Lottie
tweet: Export Lottie… → Bodymovin 5.x shape animation with trim paths and fill masks. Pixel layers, layer masks, effects cannot be preserved by this exporter (clear error) — use animated SVG for those.

title: Import Lottie
tweet: Import Lottie… brings a shape-layer Lottie onto the timeline. Basic shape subset — keep .oma for the complete editable animation. PNG/JPEG/static SVG export stays the rest pose.

title: Fifty-two templates
tweet: Templates · 52 on welcome or File → Template library. Search by name/idea, filter nine categories, pick built-in size or custom W/H/DPI. Previews adapt to proportions. Use this template or double-click.

title: Templates offline editable
tweet: Templates open as unsaved docs with editable paper, artwork, copy layers. Existing work stays in its tab. Local fonts only — no network. Portrait, square, landscape; tiny sizes omit unreadable secondary copy.

title: Three right tabs
section: Palettes & brand libraries / typography / project kits
tweet: Right sidebar tabs: Inspect (selected artwork), Palettes (reusable colors), Brand (logos, images, fonts, assets). Inspect + brand bank in one chrome — Affinity Publisher vibes without three apps.

title: Project library files
section: Palettes & brand libraries / typography / project kits
tweet: Project libraries beside your work: .omacolors (palettes), .omatype (font roles), .omabrand/ (assets + fonts). Saved doc uses nearest enclosing folder with any of these; else starts beside the document.

title: Personal vs project palettes
section: Palettes & brand libraries / typography / project kits
tweet: Palettes → Personal (across work) or Project (current folder). + Palette, name it. Filter by palette name or hex. + Current color, From selection, or type hex (+ #RRGGBBAA). Fill/Stroke then click swatch.

title: Palette save export
section: Palettes & brand libraries / typography / project kits
tweet: Palette Save is separate from artwork save. ··· → Load palettes… merges (conflicting names get suffixes). Export selected palette… or Export collection…. Duplicate/remove available.

title: Palette conflict handling
section: Palettes & brand libraries / typography / project kits
tweet: Libraries refresh ~every 3s. If file changes with unsaved palette edits, edits stay and Save blocks. Export a copy or Reload saved colors. Quit offers Save all / Discard / Cancel for unsaved palettes.

title: Brand bank load
section: Palettes & brand libraries / typography / project kits
tweet: Brand → Load bank… (project or .omabrand folder). New collection: Choose project → Create bank → edit name → Save. ··· → Add assets… copies artwork in; originals stay. Nested folders supported.

title: Brand asset place
section: Palettes & brand libraries / typography / project kits
tweet: Filter brand tiles by name, path, type (Image / SVG / omadesign). Thumbnails load in background; external changes refresh ~3s. Drag to canvas or double-click to artboard/document center. Ctrl+Z undoes place.

title: Brand accepted formats
section: Palettes & brand libraries / typography / project kits
tweet: Banks accept PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, BMP, GIF, SVG, .oma. SVG uses supported import subset. ··· → Save bank copy… clones the whole bank (name + nested folders) to another project.

title: Brand typography kit
section: Palettes & brand libraries / typography / project kits
tweet: Brand → Typography → Add fonts… copies TTF/OTF into the project. Name kit, Save name. Role names (Heading/Body/Caption) → Save role. Apply uses role on selected/next text. Fonts work inside Omadesign without system install.

title: Typography load save copy
section: Palettes & brand libraries / typography / project kits
tweet: Typography ··· → Load kit… merges another .omatype and copies fonts (keep source .omabrand/). ··· → Save copy… writes kit+fonts to another project. Remove role keeps font file for existing artwork.

title: Project fonts travel
section: Palettes & brand libraries / typography / project kits
tweet: Native .oma text stays editable after moving the project. Saving artwork into another folder also copies used faces into that folder's .omabrand/fonts/. SVG export outlines project-font text; .oma keeps editability.

title: Share project kit
section: Palettes & brand libraries / typography / project kits
tweet: Share a kit: copy .omacolors, .omatype, and complete .omabrand/ with the project. Dotfiles — enable hidden files when copying by hand. Fieldwork example ships as a portable reference.

title: Native oma format
tweet: .oma = JSON + PNG-packed rasters + motion clip. Version 5 adds frames, auto-layout, constraints, opt-in cloud metadata. Save imported work as .oma to keep editable doc + conversion notes.

title: Open layered foreign docs
tweet: File → Open: layered PSD/PSB, GIMP .xcf, every PDF page + PDF-compatible AI, OpenRaster, SVG/SVGZ, Affinity via optional bridge. Imports open in their own tab at original dimensions. Save → .oma, source preserved.

title: Place command
tweet: File → Place… Ctrl+Shift+P loads artwork in background, then click or drag to place. Nested layers and masks travel together. Undo removes placement in one step. Enter places center; Esc cancels.

title: Drop to open or place
tweet: Drop layered documents on canvas or welcome to open them; ordinary images place; .oma opens; Lottie imports. Status bar confirms copy/cut/paste. Copy style Ctrl+Alt+C, paste style Ctrl+Alt+V.

title: Conversion notes
tweet: View → Document conversion notes lists unsupported/converted features. Notes stay in .oma. Affinity native features, PS live text/smart objects/effects, AI private data — not universal. Honest import, not silent loss.

title: Export matrix
tweet: Export: PNG 1×/2×/3×, JPEG, SVG, animated SVG, Lottie JSON, layered PSD/PSB, PDF, OpenRaster. Unsupported layers may become pixel layers with notes. No native .af* or .ai writers — interchange via PDF/SVG/PSD.

title: PSD PSB bridge
tweet: PSD/PSB: native layered reader (groups, names, placement, visibility, opacity, blends, pixel masks, supported Normal color overlays). Export RGB/8-bit layered PSD/PSB. Text/smart objects → saved layer pixels.

title: Affinity optional bridge
tweet: Affinity .afdesign/.afphoto/.afpub/.aftemplate/.afpackage via optional converter (setup-affinity-import.sh). Vectors, text, pixels, groups, visibility, opacity, masks, artboards via SVG. Partial — adjustments/history often dropped.

title: PDF AI import export
tweet: PDF: pages→artboards, paths, supported text, images, optional-content layers. Export PDF with pages, vectors, OCG metadata. .ai = PDF-compatible artwork; private Illustrator data not reconstructed.

title: OpenRaster GIMP
tweet: OpenRaster import/export (layers, stack.xml, merged preview, thumbnail). .xcf native GIMP reader (no writer) — export ORA or PSD back. GIMP text/effects import as pixels; keep .oma as master.

title: Headless inspect convert
tweet: CLI: omadesign --inspect artwork.psd|afdesign|xcf|NEF|.omaphoto. --convert … --output … for .oma/.svg/.png/.jpg/.psd/.psb/.pdf/.ora. Same readers/writers as desktop. Same-file convert refused.

title: RAW headless develop
tweet: omadesign --convert photograph.dng --output photograph.tif develops full-res 16-bit via Photo pipeline; JPEG is 8-bit. .omaphoto settings apply automatically. Camera file never overwritten.

title: Cloud opt-in
tweet: Cloud is opt-in. Document stays on disk until File → Enable cloud sync. Unpublished files never appear in the gallery. Local-first for people who hate forced SaaS.

title: Sign in identity
tweet: File → Sign in… writes identity (~/.config/omadesign/cloud-identity.json on desktop; Account stores name/email on the site). Match emails when you invite a collaborator.

title: Enable sync invite
tweet: File → Enable cloud sync attaches a project id to the .oma. File → Invite collaborator… adds an email to that document. Sync without uploading every private draft by default.

title: Publish to showcase
tweet: File → Publish to showcase… is a second, explicit opt-in. /showcase is the public gallery (seeded with 0.5.0 Layout starters). /showcase/:id for one published project; private ids stay dark.

title: Collaborator project view
tweet: /project/:id collaborator view: pin, reply, resolve. Layout inspector pins match canvas comments. Without OMADESIGN_CLOUD_URL the desktop keeps a local store under ~/.local/share/omadesign/cloud-store.json.

title: Compete waitlist
tweet: omadesign.app/compete — rules plus a waitlist. Entries not required on day one. /account for sign-in identity. /api/cloud for sync, publish, waitlist (last-write-wins).

title: Lua 5.4 embedded
tweet: 0.5.8 embeds Lua 5.4 + plugin API 1. No separate runtime — Lua and examples ship inside the Linux packages. Existing installed plugins are preserved on update.

title: Manage plugins
tweet: Plugins → Manage plugins installs .lua files, folders with main.lua, or .omaplug bundles. Enable checkbox per plugin. Updates keep a hidden backup of the previous folder. Reload after editing.

title: Studio starter twelve
tweet: Studio starter (first install) has 12 actions: pixel filter, shadow effect, SVG icon, two brush presets, canvas drawing tool, pattern generator, editable gradient, persistent color palette, batch transform, two opt-in behaviors.

title: Plugin undo safety
tweet: Plugins run off the UI thread. A completed document action = one Undo step. Errors, cancellation, and stale results do not partially change your work. Edit/switch docs mid-run → result discarded.

title: Plugin categories
tweet: Plugin actions can make editable vectors, transform geometry, run pixel filters, set native effects/gradients, supply SVG icons + brush presets, add canvas tools + opt-in behaviors, install palettes, batch folders.

title: Canvas tool plugins
tweet: Tool actions: Activate tool, drag on canvas, Escape exits. Gesture previews as a line; plugin generates editable output on release. Choose Raster doc + raster layer before pixel filters/brush presets.

title: Opt-in behaviors
tweet: Document/selection behaviors off by default. Manager behavior checkbox opts into events from enabled plugins and remembers the choice. A behavior’s own output does not recursively trigger itself.

title: Host API surface
tweet: Host API: oma.add_shape, translate, set_geometry (incl. compounds), remove, set_fill, gradient (linear/radial/conic/shape), set_effects, brush, palette, svg, pixel, map_pixels, message. Fresh Lua VM per run.

title: Plugin CLI batch
tweet: omadesign --plugin … --command … --batch ./input --output-dir ./output --params '{…}'. Processes every immediate .oma in filename order. Inputs preserved; existing outputs refused. Failed file doesn't stop others.

title: Install list plugins CLI
tweet: Headless plugin ops: omadesign --install-plugin ./my-plugin and --list-plugins — no window required. Desktop for brush/palette/tool gestures; document commands batch on CLI.

title: Plugin sandbox limits
tweet: Plugins cannot exec programs, hit the network, or read arbitrary files. No io/os/package/debug/require. Limits: 15s, 64 MiB heap, 20k edits. Distribute as .omaplug ZIP. No remote marketplace in this release.

title: Starter source path
tweet: Fresh Studio starter source lives in ~/.local/share/omadesign/plugin-examples/studio-starter after install. Fork Omadesign, add plugins/, PR with README, license, .oma example, undo/cancel verification.

title: Adobe familiar tool keys
tweet: Tool keys: V A P N R O Y S L T G I U B E K J Shift+J M C W H Z. Same letters Affinity/Adobe users already have in muscle memory — F1 HUD teaches the rest while you draw.

title: File and edit keys
tweet: Ctrl+Z/Shift+Z undo/redo. Ctrl+D duplicate. Ctrl+C/V/X copy/paste/cut. Ctrl+A select all. Ctrl+S / Shift+S save/save as. Ctrl+O open. Ctrl+N new. Ctrl+Shift+P place. Ctrl+E export.

title: Arrange and transform keys
tweet: Ctrl+G combine / Ctrl+Shift+G release. Ctrl+Shift+] front / Ctrl+Shift+[ back. Ctrl+T free transform. Ctrl+; guides. Ctrl+Shift+; snapping (hold Ctrl to reverse). Ctrl+/ HUD. F1 all shortcuts.

title: View and motion keys
tweet: Ctrl+0 fit · Ctrl+1 100% · Ctrl++/- zoom · Space pan · pinch/Ctrl-scroll zoom. Motion: Space play · K key · Home/End · Delete selected key or animation. One keymap across personas.

title: Native dialogs context
tweet: Native file dialogs. Right-click canvas for Place, Trace, and the same edits. Status bar reports copy/cut/paste. No Electron file picker tax.

title: Plugins offline docs
tweet: 0.5.8 packages include Lua, offline documentation, the creation skill, plugin examples and licenses. Install once; author plugins without hunting a CDN.

title: One binary not three apps
tweet: Affinity's StudioLink is clever. Omadesign's personas sit in the same native Linux binary with Adobe-familiar keys (V/P/T/B) and an F1 HUD that teaches while you draw. No app-hopping for one poster.

title: Vectors pixels photo motion
tweet: Adobe makes you bounce Illustrator ↔ Photoshop ↔ After Effects. Omadesign keeps Design, Pixel, Photo, and Motion in one .oma with one layer stack — plus Layout frames when the brief is UI.

title: Brand kit on disk
tweet: .omacolors + .omatype + .omabrand/ travel with the project folder. Palettes, role fonts, logos — no Creative Cloud Libraries login to open yesterday's kit on another Linux box.

title: RAW sidecars not destructive
tweet: Photo writes .omaphoto beside the camera file. Whole-folder preset apply never touches pixels. Place in Design when ready. Lightroom-style non-destructive develop without leaving the studio binary.

title: Plugins without ExtendScript tax
tweet: 0.5.8 Lua plugins: filters, FX, icons, brushes, tools, patterns, gradients, swatches, batch CLI. Sandboxed, one-undo, no separate runtime. Adobe ExtendScript / Affinity macros — meet a Linux-native host API.

title: Import honesty export choice
tweet: Open PSD, PDF, SVG, ORA, XCF, Affinity (bridge), RAW. Conversion notes stay in .oma. Export PNG×3, SVG, Lottie, PSD, PDF, ORA. Interchange without pretending every proprietary effect round-trips.

title: Cloud optional showcase explicit
tweet: Enable cloud sync when you want it. Invite by email. Publish to showcase is a second opt-in. Unpublished stays private. Collaboration without making SaaS the default document store.

title: Linux first creative suite
tweet: curl install to ~/.local/bin. Omarchy theme + Phosphor. ARM64 + x86_64. Templates offline. Lua in-package. Built for people who live on Linux and still need Illustrator/Photo/Publisher-class work.
